scope: 30 core tests cover exact 2,500-target area damage, XP conservation, legal upgrades, fixed-step inputs, deterministic seeds, projectiles, airframe continuity, terminal precedence and native family adaptations: sprinter warning/burst/travel, optional courier/refuge rewards, bounded non-stacking support, rally direction, source-death cancellation and support-only attack exclusions.

Both fixtures simulate 901 seconds with real family behaviors, six support and two aimed-attack specialists, retain 1500/700 or 2500/1200 counts, at least 45/60 occupied screen regions, maximum 100 or 160 actors per region, and distinct visible positions at 390/600/901 seconds.

12 renderer tests use finite Phaser/DOM adapters. Actual renderer.present calls test phase/reward cues, reduced-effects parity, no per-frame painting/uploading, and no simulation mutation. Paired real cores run for 600 ticks and retain equal full simulation and summary.
limits: No actual browser or GPU driver is exercised by the finite renderer adapter.
Node duration is not FPS, heap stability, thermal or target-device acceptance.
The source list binds the directly qualified mode/compiler/test files; it is not a complete repository or release-source manifest.
